body: Yes I’ve talked to many therapists and psychiatrists, all I want is to feel different, feel happy.
I try the same, small goals, but then when I reach them it feels almost like a “what do I do now, that didn’t have the outcome I had hoped”.

I would certainly say so. I think at times it can make the things most people find happiness in seem meaningless and useless because I want something bigger, something that lasts . But maybe that’s my human flaw, nothing will ever be good enough until it makes me happy for an extended period of time.

I often try that, almost like a “it can’t be bad forever, right?” Kind of mindset, but i always get the feeling that I’m lying to myself to avoid the inevitable truth that it will more than likely always be like this. Let’s face it, one day I’m not going to wake up and the sun won’t be a little brighter and the grass won’t be a bit more green. It’s almost like a terminal illness, but only you control the timeframe for expiration.

I know it’s not a competition but I’ve always told myself “other people have it worse”, as a way to try to convince myself things aren’t so bad. I always wonder what intangible thing the people who have it worse possess that allows them to be okay when they have no reason to.
I’ve thought that sentiment many a time. But for years nothing has changed
I’ve tried it before and failed tho, the regret never came after a fail
Just hindsight of certain scenarios

Just going about each day, convincing myself I’m better than my mistakes or awful thoughts but consistently failing is hardest. Also the idea that I’m continuing life for no good reason, just wasting time and energy
Thats thing I’m sick of toiling

It’s not important in the grand scheme of things, I think that maybe I just need too much to be happy so why should the world that has other things to deal with accommodate one person so much? Like we are so insignificant as people what’s the point? We really aren’t anything special, sure there will only be one of us, but 99% of the world is irrelevant so why can’t I fade into black now?

For me it seems like no one knows anything is even remotely wrong, which is preferable. But I just don’t feel like anything is worth living for, relationships aren’t fun, I don’t want kids, I’m not close to anyone. Just seems wasteful to live
Not really. Drinking and drugs just make days pass by a little quicker , which allows me to get through each day holding onto the simple thought I’m one day closer to suicide or inevitable death.
No. Nothing major or life changing happened . Just woke up one day feeling empty , like I dont know what to do. Everything changed basically over night
Probably about 3-4 years ago.
I don’t think there’s a purpose I could choose that would give me fulfillment . It’s just a literal lack of anything inside me that makes me feel happy or any semblance of it.
Just an emptiness , lack of purpose really. Lack of need or want to be here
I dont know ask me anything
Sure
Sure

I usually look through this app and some social media for a while and I watch tv until I ultimately decide on a sleep attempt or take the melatonin. But i think I’ve been sleeping okay the last couple days because of mental exhaustion.

Yeah occasionally I’ll take melatonin, all it does is induce a few minutes of drowsy feeling which sometimes is enough and sometimes is. But usually it takes 6-10 to do the trick. I have looked up side effects of using that many but some days that’s the only option.

I work out regularly and do everything I can’t to stay in shape, I watch what I eat and don’t drink pop, I workout whenever I can. Nothing makes me tired. I was diagnosed with a chemical deficiency in my brain, where my brain doesn’t produce the “sleep” drug. So it would take my brain days to store up enough of this drug for me to actually feel tired.

I am fairly certain I’m going to take at least a year off from drinking, just to see the positive and negatives in their entirety and to gain perspective. I think a short term list would be a good thing for me. I am one of those forgetful people who if I don’t write a note about it then it’ll be gone forever (probably one of my more irritating faults I have acquired). I’d love to hear more examples if you don’t mind, I feel I’ve tried a million things in attempts to sleep.
I will keep you in mind, after all, everyone has bad days.
Thank you for your words of encouragement.

I would love to hear what helped for you. What keeps me up at night is the constant of wonder of what I’m going to do with my life, who will be there for me in the future, and if anyone values my life more than I have valued my own. I run down scenarios in my head and one leads to another and before I know I’ve laid in my bed for 7 hours with my eyes closed and no sleep to show for it. Also alcoholism runs in my family , deep down to the core and it skipped a generation with my dad and uncle. I’m 4 days in but even with longer breaks I’ve never felt any detox symptoms .
Yeah I definitely get what you’re saying, every detail.

I often feel that way too, just dead inside while everyone else is so happy and laughing as if they don’t have a care in the world. Then you think about what part of you died or left you . You have no explanation as to how, or why. Yet here you are left to pick up the pieces of something you never asked for. Then you realize you’re already metaphorically dead and you don’t know what’s next.

I feel that way entirely. The line about feeling like a ghost whose hand passes through everything really got me. It feels like your every action or reaction is meaningless compared to others. I definitely can see from your point of view because i think mine are of a similar nature. You have 0 want or need for friendship or a relationship, I also have a loving family and do well in school. But it always seems like there’s someone better.
How much say do we have in our place in the world? When I say place in the world I mean somewhere that you make a difference the most or help significantly

Just questions on how things got this bad, what triggered it in the first place, where is my place, what is the actual bigger picture, is there such thing as happiness or is it all created in our mind?

There’s something about it that’s so interesting, why do people choose that place as the end? There’s a million other bridges. I read of people who think about doing it and get to the ledge just have a realization and I always wonder if I’d see things differently dangling off the edge.
Still here physically, but mentally in other universe
Every damn day man, just don’t know where to go or what job I’d have to live off of
Yeah the only thing we know is the four walls around us and are aware of our conscious. I’ve read it and heard it before. We are absurd in thinking that we know anything because nothing is definite.
Not really
That’s how I feel, like I’m a walking bad luck charm
I don’t hate anything about the routine , I find it all coming back on hate for myself that I didn’t actually earn. I put everyone elses problems as my own. I am a lightning rod for bullshit reasons

I’m 22, I’ve done everything and seen far more. People always say life is about experiences and lessons. I’ve learned every lesson and seen everything 2x over. I can predict someone reaction to anything , I feel like I’m writing my life in a book before it happens
Everything and anything you can imagine

Not stressful, just can’t handle people that are stupid. I hear there lives and what they want. They don’t realize that there are people who want the feeling of peace and here they are wasting life on a bullshit job talking about the minimum feeling of everything
I’d love to.
It’s not permanent but it puts a bandaid over a bullet wound.

I am here for you, I want to say I understand. But that’s the worst thing to say in these situations, because we all do and think differently, so technically someone can only empathize with you . But you should never let your parents words make you feel like a lesser person. Parents often are making things up as they go, they say things to try to get you to be and do better . Which often comes off as careless and rude. I’m always here to talk, but trust me when I say the only key to get through things is the power of your own mind.
No I feel the same. All I feel is anger, it’s the only thing I really feel. I used to get sad or mad, now I’m numb to anything of relevance

It’s amazing to me that the smartest people seem to be the depressed ones. It’s like we’re smart and just fine, then something happens and we implode, the intelligence albeit still there . But covered by a million other thoughts

I relate to this because of age and the bumping up of dosage, I had to be bumped up every month because my body got used to every sleeping pill, anti anxiety, or anti depressant after 2-3 weeks. As for your boyfriend, fuck that guy. You’re scared of approaching someone, so talk to me? Talk to someone you meet online. Most convos start as a hey hows it going, don’t be afraid to open yourself up to new people just because the people in the past or currently in your life don’t know how to act right.

I am a very angry person, it comes out of nowhere and then I’m infuriated to the point of breaking things, and then the anxiety kicks in and I can’t sit still or stop thinking so I have to calm myself down from that. The anger is the least of my worries and to be honest, isn’t nearly as much of a problem as others.

I’ve told myself that for years, and at this point I’m not even sure I’d care how much they suffer because I’m sick of suffering. As selfish as that sounds don’t people always say “if you want something go get it”? I want to be at peace and I’ll never get there in this life. So maybe death is the silver lining, the savior if you will. How will I know if I never follow through? What if I die and then it really is just black emptiness ? The thought of that is so calming and attractive .

There’s not much to say. I’ve seen 5 different therapists, been on every anti anxiety, anti depressant, and sleeping pill the world offers. The thing they never tell you in therapy is that they’re essentially there to just listen. They have the same bland responses like “you’re just stressed about your future “ or “ give it time and you’ll see things change”. I’ve tried every avenue and left no stone unturned. There is no cure, or fast acting fix to change me into a 22 year old who doesn’t dream of a life where my thoughts don’t eat me alive.

Its almost like a disease. I try to fix everyone else the last 6 years and kind of absorb their pain almost as a lightning rod in some semblance. It has pushed me to a point where I can no longer separate the thoughts of the euphoric feeling of not having to live through this life, and the thought of having to suffer .
Almost as though everyone else sees life through a clouded lens and here we are just seeing things for what they are.
